summary: Pole L-4 lookout tower near Elk City, Idaho, built about 1930 and destroyed in 1960; sources disagree on its height. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1960 per firelookout.com, Forest Lookouts and a Forest Service list; no source describes the site since then

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists it as hike-in; no route is given in the sources read

events.note: Built about 1930 (approximate year in all sources)

evidence.supports: about eight miles east of Elk City
Nez Perce National Forest managing agency
c.1930 round timber tower with R-1 style L-4 cab
evidence.quote: was erected with a R-1 style L-4 cab.
1960: The lookout tower and cab were destroyed.

sources.title: Blackhawk Mtn. Fire Lookout Tower
sources.publisher: firelookout.com (Rex Kamstra's Forest Fire Lookout pages)

sources.title: Nez Perce National Forest Lookouts
sources.publisher: USDA Forest Service (list compiled April 2010 from Kresek and other sources)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts give 25 feet; the Forest Lookouts page gives about 28 feet; the Forest Service list gives 40 feet. No single height is recorded.

notes_for_editor: Brief record (gone, L-4, tower, Nez Perce NF) is consistent with the sources, so no correction. Heights conflict (25, 28, 40 feet), so none is recorded in facts. No staffing source was found, so staffing is omitted. In the Forest Service list the 1950s entry is a photo year, not a staffing year, and is not used. Forest Lookouts includes a 1960 Idaho State Journal item about an unrelated shooting near the site; it is left out. Firelookout.com and the Forest Service list credit a Nez Perce NF photo, but no image URL was found, so no photo is recorded. No source describes the site today or public access.
